usedFor: Hostfully holds bookings and inquiries and Calendly sets up calls, so “New Booking Inquiry” can run “Create One-Time Meeting”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking Inquiry” in Hostfully, then “Create One-Time Meeting” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A new inquiry opens a one-time meeting in Calendly, so a call with the guest is ready to schedule.

watchOut: “Cancelled Booking” and “Updated Booking” in Hostfully can feed “Create One-Time Meeting” too, so pick the trigger carefully.
